_comment: Tier 2 native renderer parity vs the Tier 1 engine path. Source of truth for the CI flip rule: every visual/logic capability the headless QA runner constructs (buildScene) must appear here. Statuses: full | partial | missing | web-tier (runs WebView-side under Option A, never native). Update this file when adding runner capabilities; CI fails otherwise.

MeshRenderer.notes: Native flattens all shapes to instanced cubes; no per-shape geometry.

InstancedMeshBatcher.notes: Indirect instanced draws with compute culling.

TerrainChunk/WorldStreamer.notes: Baked terrain_lod leaves at export focus; no runtime refocus/streaming.

LightComponent.notes: Light records parsed; renderer uses single hardcoded directional light.

CameraComponent.notes: Camera hardcoded lookAt({14,30,44}); no configurable camera.

AnimeCelShader/cel.notes: Loop vocabulary exists; no native cel shader.

RigidBody3D/Collider3D.notes: PhysicsType parsed then ignored; no native physics.

VehicleController.notes: Raycast-vehicle physics web-tier under Option A; chassis mesh renders via the MeshRenderer path (cube-flattened).

MobileController/input.notes: Exp-2 probe only (tap path proven, staged motion); not productized.

syncInstances-transport.notes: Exp-1: positions-only in-place sync; JNI 33us mean; host-device race open; no spawn/material/event records yet.

WeaponController.notes: Gameplay logic stays WebView-side under Option A.

HealthComponent.notes: Gameplay logic stays WebView-side under Option A.

EnemyAI.notes: Gameplay logic stays WebView-side under Option A.

ElementalReactionComponent.notes: Gameplay logic stays WebView-side under Option A.

DialogueManager.notes: Gameplay logic stays WebView-side under Option A.

GameRuntime/Settlement.notes: Gameplay logic stays WebView-side under Option A.

WorldStreamer-runtime.notes: Covered above as TerrainChunk partial; runtime refocus is the missing half.
